minutes.headline: Select Board held off on an ambulance fee increase and asked the fire chief for a fuller cost analysis first.
minutes.summary: The board heard the fire chief's request to raise ambulance rates. Members split between covering costs and avoiding a large one-step jump. The board also approved a common victualler license and a letter supporting the Summer Street project, and discussed the town manager's self-evaluation.

what_happened.line: The Select Board took no vote on an ambulance rate increase and asked the fire chief and town manager to revise the cost spreadsheet and return.
The fire chief proposed raising ambulance rates, last changed years ago, to offset department costs; members split between covering costs and avoiding one large step.
The billing company's estimate of added annual revenue was discussed, with part requested to cover salary and supply overruns.
The board approved a common victualler license for Amber's Pizzeria.
The board voted to send a letter supporting reconstruction of Summer and North Streets to the regional planning commission.

why_it_matters: Ambulance rates are paid by patients and their insurers, and the revenue offsets department costs that would otherwise fall on the town budget, mostly taxes, so the size and timing of any increase affects both.
The Summer and North Streets letter is a step toward regional planning commission funding for road reconstruction, not a commitment of money.
